summary: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj filed a Form 6-K (foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a routine current report) furnishing its Q3 and first-nine-months 2026 interim results, an earnings press release and FY2026 guidance, all dated November 5, 2026. Metrics include EUR 42.2 million of Q3 orders, year-to-date intake of EUR 52.9 million, an order backlog of EUR 102.5 million (up 52% from year start), Q3 revenue of EUR 8.9 million (up 51% year-over-year) and cash of EUR 260.4 million at September 30. No transaction, stake, board recommendation or structural mechanics is disclosed; this is an ordinary earnings filing with no special-situations angle.
